policy: V7 preserves all prior snapshot/trace generations and adds a Merkle-sealed accounting close over a contiguous LedgerEvent prefix plus independently verifiable event inclusion proofs.

additions.authority_note: Financial OS sealing artifact binding exact FinancialSnapshot v2 digest to a contiguous ledger prefix Merkle root, sequence span, valuation-policy digest and requirement-registry digest. It cannot execute transactions or recognize revenue itself.
Provenance-only Merkle proof that one exact LedgerEvent v1 belongs to the ledger root sealed by a specific AccountingClose v1.
